gaps: Ceramic animal figurines (panther, zebra, tiger, elephant, peacock, flamingo): pngimg/freepngimg animal categories are live-animal photos or flat silhouettes; only figurine-like hits were a JPG (wallpapers.com golden panther) and a black silhouette (freepngimg). No hi-res alpha found.

Black-and-gold cocktail shaker and cut-crystal decanter: only 896 px alpha cutouts (pngpix, wallpapers.com); pngimg whisky/cocktail categories are bottles and drinks. The cut-crystal goblet is the nearest keeper.
Murano / sea-glass chandelier: only brass-with-frosted-bowls (keeper) and crystal/gold chandeliers.
Lucite/acrylic pieces, neon-style signs, ice buckets, brass candlesticks (7269 failed corners), vintage cameras and clapperboards (tight crops fail corners): no passing hi-res alpha.
Photographic disco ball: the 1000+ px balls are 3D-render/vector illustrations; the 'realistic' ones in the 1020xx series are only 400-600 px.
Wikimedia Commons not searched in depth (its cocktail-shaker category is mostly JPG photos).
notes: All files come from pngimg.com; nothing from the other allowed hosts survived the resolution/corner gate. Gate in the brief applied numerically, then composites on burgundy and white, then 100% crops of every edge-contact run and of silhouette boundaries for all 12 keepers (sheets in artifacts/demo-sourcing/round2/decor-scripts/sheet_edges.jpg and sheet_silh.jpg). Nothing was background-removed or edited by me.

Edge rule applied uniformly: a curved contour grazing the canvas edge (tangent) or a thin tether (chain, rod, wire, cord) leaving it is accepted if the body is whole; a flat cut through the body is rejected. Hanging disco balls 117287/117295/117296 (wire exits top, body whole) would pass this rule; deleted only because three balls were enough.
Disco balls and some other files are very large (up to 8000 px, ~10 MB); downscale before putting them in the site.

also_in_dir files pass the numeric gate but were only seen on contact sheets; treat as unreviewed spares (disco 117284/117286/117288/117289/117290/117291/117299 are gold, rainbow, pastel and red-hanging variants; lamps 108713, 108730, 108737; chandeliers 109033, 109036, 109043; phone 48904 wood-bodied rotary; perfume 99984 blue atomizer).
Held-back rotary-phone-red-coiled: top run is 139 px (6.3% of width) of flat-looking red; inspect before using.
